sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Fisherman's Island State Park campsites via the booking site's /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 2027-07-13 and 2027-09-21; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: DNR park page banner (read 2026-10-25): 'Rustic campground closed for the season, day-use areas temporarily closed to vehicle traffic. Due to culvert replacement work, Fisherman's Island State Park's rustic campground is closed for the season ... The park is slated to reopen once concrete curing is complete. Updates on a park reopening date will be posted here.'
$20 a night for every site on the booking site in 2026 and 2027 (rustic rate in the DNR 2026 table). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ feeDetails ($20 on 2026-10-27, 2027-05-18, 07-13 and 09-21) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (North and South Campgrounds: rustic $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fishermans ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fishermans ('There are no modern restrooms, showers or electricity available') + midnrreservations.com site attributes (all 79 sites 'Electrical Service=Not Available, Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 80 sites 'ideal for tents and compact campers': most in three loops, 15 in the dune area along Lake Michigan. The booking site lists 79 (North and South maps); its allowed lengths run 20-50 ft (six North sites to 50 ft), and 11 take tents only.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fishermans ('There are 80 campsites ideal for tents and compact campers. Most sites are located within three loops, and 15 sites are nestled in the dune area along Lake Michigan'; 'Number of sites: 80') + midnrreservations.com resources (allowed equipment per site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Vault toilets and hand-pumped water in each loop.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fishermans ('Vault toilets and hand-pumped water are available in each loop. There are no modern restrooms, showers or electricity available'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservable online or at 1-800-447-2757 from May 1 to Sept. 14; first come, first served Sept. 15 - Nov. 30.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/fishermans ('Reservations can be made online at MiDNRReservations.com or by calling 1-800-447-2757 May 1-Sept. 14. Reservations are first come, first served Sept. 15-Nov. 30.') + DNR rates table (reservation season May 1 - September 14), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground in Fisherman's Island State Park, 4 miles from downtown Charlevoix: rolling wooded dunes on 6 miles of Lake Michigan shoreline (the south end primitive). Most sites sit in three loops; 15 are in the dunes along the lake. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: closure banner (campground closed for the season for culvert replacement; reopening date to be posted) -> status temporarily_closed. Confirmed $20 (2026-2027), no electric, 80 sites (79 bookable, to 50 ft; max_rig_ft new), vault toilets and hand pumps, no showers/flush toilets, reservable May 1 - Sept 14 with first-come Sept 15 - Nov 30 (booking.note). fcfs (derived after_cutoff) left: the vocabulary has no seasonal first-come value. Season (derived) left. Phone matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
